name: rvm
description: Ruby binary checksums pinned in the repo DB, enforced by default. Caveats: a URL-check helper uses curl --insecure; Rubinius/self-update paths are weaker.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: RVM uses versioned MD5 and SHA-512 checksum databases for Ruby archive validation. The full original statement also covers URL-check and Rubinius/self-update exceptions that are not established by this bounded evidence.
limitations: The retained source covers installer checksum enforcement, not release signing.
The Rubinius fallback and separate self-updater key retrieval are outside the pinned-checksum observation.

original_evidence.text: | rvm | https://github.com/rvm/rvm.git | 75462ea / 2026-07-30 | Y | N | Y | https, TLS enforced for the actual archive download; **but** a HEAD "does this URL exist" helper hardcodes `curl --insecure` unconditionally | N | **hash (MD5+SHA512)**, pinned in versioned repo source by default; enforced (install fails if no checksum found and `rvm_verify_downloads_flag` default=1); Rubinius binaries are the one exception — their checksum is fetched from the *same* host over HTTPS at runtime | pinned-in-repo (`rvm/config/md5`,`rvm/config/sha512`, git-shipped) for the default path; server-supplied/same-endpoint for the Rubinius-only fallback | `rvm/scripts/functions/checksum` (whole file, esp. `__rvm_checksum_read:197-214` reading `rvm_path/config/md5`\|`sha512`, then `:217-230` HTTP fallback only for `*rubinius*` URLs); `rvm/scripts/fetch:28-30` fails if no checksum found and verify flag on; `:222-227` `rvm_fail` + delete archive on mismatch; `rvm/scripts/functions/utility:288` `__rvm_curl --silent --insecure --location --list-only --head` (unconditional, existence-check only — main `fetch_command` at `rvm/scripts/fetch:21` has no `--insecure`). Separately, RVM's own self-updater (`rvm/binscripts/rvm-installer:397-461`) verifies a PGP `.asc` signature but the signing keys are fetched from `hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com` or `https://rvm.io/mpapis.asc` — **not pinned** in the repo (`:426-431`). |
